track.title: Lost Digits 02
track.instrumentation: Cracked Piano 11 + Digital String 3 + Glitter + HyperGlass Lead 4

segments.text: Four voices enter a field 51 semitones wide. The Glitter bass detonates at pitch 28 — velocity 122, the loudest event in the signal. Everything above it trembles.

Cracked Piano spans 31 semitones in 14 notes. It reaches from the bass register up to G5 — the widest voice, searching across three octaves. Digital String mirrors it from below, locked between C3 and D4.

HyperGlass Lead hovers in a tight 8-semitone band: E4 to C5. Velocity decaying from 40 to 14. A signal losing power. The Glitter bass fires again — pitch 29, one semitone higher. The only chromatic movement in the lowest register.
49 notes compressed into 8.5 seconds. D/D# dominant. Harmonic ratio 6.87:1 — almost no percussive boundary. Four digits, different magnitudes, same dissolution.
